![critical](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/critical.svg)

The greedy search implementation in `panphon_gsearch` is buggy. It incorrectly handles out-of-vocabulary (OOV) characters that follow a valid phone, and the main loop iterator `i` is not correctly managed, leading to incorrect tokenization. This can result in wrong phone sequences and OOV reporting.

```python
def panphon_gsearch(seq, root, with_supraseg=True):
    """
    Greedy longest-match-first search in panphon trie. 
    seq: input sequence (string)
    root: root node of the trie
    with_supraseg: if False, remove suprasegmental diacritics before search
    return: list of phones and set of OOV phones
    """
    seq = clean(seq, with_supraseg)  # fix unicode and remove punctuations
    res, oov = [], set()
    i, N = 0, len(seq)
    while i < N:
        node = root
        # Find longest match from current position i
        longest_match_val = None
        longest_match_len = 0
        
        j = i
        temp_node = node
        while j < N and seq[j] in temp_node.children:
            temp_node = temp_node.children[seq[j]]
            j += 1
            if temp_node.is_end_of_word:
                longest_match_val = temp_node.value
                longest_match_len = j - i
        
        if longest_match_val:
            res.append(longest_match_val)
            i += longest_match_len
        else:
            # No match found starting at i. Treat as OOV.
            # Advance until a character is found that can start a phone.
            oov_start = i
            i += 1
            while i < N and seq[i] not in root.children:
                i += 1
            oov.add((seq[oov_start:i], None))
    
    return res, oov
```

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

This module reads the `local/panphon_ipas` file at import time. This is considered bad practice as it creates a side effect upon module import and makes the module dependent on a file that might not exist when it's imported by other tools or scripts, potentially causing an unexpected `FileNotFoundError`. This logic should be moved to `local/generate_nlsyms.py` where `PHONEME_VOCABULARY` is actually used.

Please remove these lines from this file. Then, in `egs2/powsm/s2t1/local/generate_nlsyms.py`, remove the import of `PHONEME_VOCABULARY` from `utils` and add the loading logic inside the `if __name__ == "__main__"` block:
```python
# In egs2/powsm/s2t1/local/generate_nlsyms.py
if __name__ == "__main__":
    with open("local/panphon_ipas", "r") as f:
        panphon_ipas = f.readlines()
        panphon_ipas = sorted([line.strip() for line in panphon_ipas])
    PHONEME_VOCABULARY = set(panphon_ipas)

    # ... rest of the code
```

Is it included in this repo?

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Downloading a file from a raw GitHub URL within a script can be fragile. The URL might change, or network issues could lead to a failed or partial download. The current implementation doesn't handle such failures gracefully, which could break the data preparation process. It's better to add error handling to make the script more robust.

```suggestion
    wget -O ipa_all.csv https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dmort27/panphon/master/panphon/data/ipa_all.csv
    if [ ! -s ipa_all.csv ] || ! head -n 1 ipa_all.csv | grep -q "syl,"; then
        log "ERROR: Failed to download or downloaded incorrect ipa_all.csv from panphon."
        rm -f ipa_all.csv
        exit 1
    fi
    cut -d',' -f1 ipa_all.csv > local/panphon_ipas
    sed -i '1d' local/panphon_ipas
    rm ipa_all.csv
```

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

This module reads the `local/panphon_ipas` file at import time. This is considered bad practice as it creates a side effect upon module import and makes the module dependent on a file that might not exist when it's imported by other tools or scripts, potentially causing an unexpected `FileNotFoundError`. This logic should be moved to `local/generate_nlsyms.py` where `PHONEME_VOCABULARY` is actually used.

Please remove these lines from this file. Then, in `egs2/powsm/s2t1/local/generate_nlsyms.py`, remove the import of `PHONEME_VOCABULARY` from `utils` and add the loading logic inside the `if __name__ == "__main__"` block:
```python
# In egs2/powsm/s2t1/local/generate_nlsyms.py
if __name__ == "__main__":
    with open("local/panphon_ipas", "r") as f:
        panphon_ipas = f.readlines()
        panphon_ipas = sorted([line.strip() for line in panphon_ipas])
    PHONEME_VOCABULARY = set(panphon_ipas)

    # ... rest of the code
```

Do you mean that we need to install the PanPhon package?
Is it included in this repo?

+# 🐁POWSM
+
+POWSM is the first phonetic foundation model that can perform four phone-related tasks:
+Phone Recognition (PR), Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), audio-guided grapheme-to-phoneme conversion (G2P), and audio-guided phoneme-to-grapheme
+conversion (P2G).
+
+Based on [Open Whisper-style Speech Model (OWSM)](https://www.wavlab.org/activities/2024/owsm/) and trained with [IPAPack++](https://huggingface.co/anyspeech), POWSM outperforms or matches specialized PR models of similar size (Wav2Vec2Phoneme and ZIPA) while jointly supporting G2P, P2G, and ASR.
+
+The model checkpoint is available on [HuggingFace](https://huggingface.co/espnet/powsm)!
+
+
+## Results
+
+Please refer to our paper for comprehensive evaluations, while below are selected results on phone recognition:
+
+### Unseen languages
